user_reported_bug: when a user edits an element (changes its value or properties), the estimation calculations are not updating correctly also the cost breakdown,utilities summary percentages ,boq , the confience score is constant too..everything needs to be recalculated and updated. The calculations work fine on first load but break after an edit. — user reported this again after previous fix, saying they were editing 'somewhere else' (not the Project Overview dialog), and NOTHING was updating.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused verification of /estimator edit recalculation passed: wizard stepper edits, slider edit, Project Overview dialog edit, repeated edits in one session, manual Recalculate, currency formatting, and confidence-affecting fields all updated visible output and called /api/estimator/calculate-fast only once per edit in tested flows.
critical_code_review_comments: Code review confirmed the fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/Estimator.jsx: a debounced useEffect on inputs calls recalc(inputs), and wizard/dialog save paths now only mutate inputs. Runtime network evidence showed 1 calculate-fast call per tested edit, not a loop.

Observation: a pure length/geometry edit updates total, cost/m², donut percentages, and BOQ percentages/rows, but absolute Utilities Summary amounts remain unchanged because backend utility costs are capacity/scope driven, not geometry driven. A utility-affecting wizard edit (production_capacity_tpd 120→200) did update the Utilities Summary amounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend script against localhost:8001 verified calculate-fast totals/confidence: baseline $47,532,524.70; length 300 $55,074,332.16; pile foundation $49,086,265.21; contingency 15 $50,613,336.48; India region $22,732,869.67; currency EUR left USD total unchanged; confidence moved to retrofit 88, brownfield 86, remote 88, brownfield+complexity 83. Browser automation on localhost:3000 used the real UI; frontend calls went through REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to the preview backend and returned 200.
rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction flow tested: on /estimator, edit via stepper without pressing the wizard's final Calculate Estimate button. The new inputs effect now catches those setInputs changes and refreshes result state after the debounce. Evidence: length 185→300 changed KPI total $47,532,525→$55,074,332, cost/m² $2,569→$1,836, BOQ % and donut % changed, and one calculate-fast response was observed. Further repeated edits changed totals: production capacity 200→$76,782,064, pile foundation→$79,118,560, contingency 15%→$84,246,614, India region→$40,291,720. Confidence was not constant: 92 baseline, 88 retrofit, 86 brownfield, 88 remote, and 85 after remote+brownfield complexity in UI.
